neubauer.titolo: Dovere di protezione (Art. 2 Abs. 2 GG) contro i rischi climatici: mitigazione, adattamento, dimensione solo oggettiva verso le generazioni future
neubauer.testo:
The fundamental right to life and physical integrity obliges the State to protect
against the risks of climate change through mitigation embedded in international
action and adaptation, an objective duty that extends to future generations.

neubauer.titolo: Vorwirkung: le quantità di emissione ammesse oggi interferiscono già con la libertà futura; i diritti fondamentali come garanzia intertemporale di libertà
neubauer.testo:
Because every emission allowed today irreversibly consumes the remaining budget and
narrows future freedom, current emission allowances have an advance interference-like
effect on fundamental rights as intertemporal guarantees of freedom.

neubauer.titolo: Proporzionalità fra generazioni: nessuna generazione può consumare il budget lasciando alle successive una riduzione radicale
neubauer.testo:
Proportionality forbids one generation from consuming large portions of the carbon
budget under a comparatively mild reduction burden while leaving subsequent
generations a radical reduction burden and serious losses of freedom.

neubauer.titolo: Il budget di CO₂ come parametro: la soglia di temperatura tradotta in budget nazionale residuo, con dovere di cura sotto incertezza
neubauer.testo:
The constitutionally relevant temperature limit is converted into a remaining national
carbon budget derived from the global budget; despite uncertainties, reliable
indications that the limit may be exceeded must inform the allowed emission amounts.

neubauer.titolo: L'obiettivo climatico costituzionale è norma giustiziabile che vincola la politica; il legislatore è tenuto alla propria concretizzazione del target
neubauer.testo:
The constitutional climate objective is a justiciable norm that binds a political
process structurally prone to short-termism, and the legislature is held to its own
specification of the temperature target unless it transparently redefines it.

neubauer.titolo: Dovere di protezione verso chi vive all'estero: pensabile in principio, di contenuto diverso, lasciato aperto (ricorrenti del Bangladesh e del Nepal)
neubauer.testo:
It is conceivable that duties of protection oblige the State towards persons abroad
exposed to warming caused partly by its emissions, though such a duty would differ in
content since adaptation abroad is impossible.

future-generations.titolo: Conexidad: i diritti fondamentali sono determinati dall'ecosistema; senza ambiente sano non sopravvivono i sujetos de derecho né famiglia, società e Stato
future-generations.testo:
Fundamental rights to life, health, subsistence and dignity are substantially
determined by the ecosystem; without a healthy environment neither subjects of law nor
sentient beings can survive, nor can family, society or the State exist.

future-generations.titolo: I diritti ambientali delle generazioni future come obbligo di non-fare che limita la libertà delle presenti
future-generations.testo:
The environmental rights of future generations, grounded in the solidarity of the
species and the intrinsic value of nature, create a binding obligation of non-action
that limits the freedom of action of present generations.

future-generations.titolo: Equità intergenerazionale: il riscaldamento previsto lede già i giovani ricorrenti
future-generations.testo:
Where scientific projections show that temperatures will rise within the lifetime of
the young claimants, the principle of intergenerational equity is already breached
unless present generations halt the causes of that warming.

future-generations.titolo: Deforestazione come fonte climatica: danno imminente alle generazioni presenti e future, corresponsabilità dello Stato per solidarietà
future-generations.testo:
Uncontrolled deforestation releases carbon dioxide and produces the greenhouse effect,
an imminent and serious harm to present and future generations that the State, by
solidarity, is co-responsible for halting at its causes.

future-generations.titolo: Un intero bioma riconosciuto come soggetto di diritti, come rimedio in un ricorso climatico
future-generations.testo:
To protect an ecosystem vital for the global future, a court may recognise it as a
subject of rights, entitled to protection, conservation, maintenance and restoration
by the State and the territorial entities.

future-generations.titolo: Il criterio ecocentrico-antropico: l'uomo a la par dell'ecosistema, i diritti come derechos-deberes
future-generations.testo:
Environmental protection must transcend anthropocentrism in favour of an
ecocentric-anthropic criterion that places the human being on a par with the ecosystem
and redefines rights as rights-duties towards nature and future generations.

future-generations.titolo: Procedibilità della tutela per conexidad quando la lesione del diritto collettivo lede diritti fondamentali
future-generations.testo:
Although collective rights are ordinarily protected through other actions, the
individual constitutional remedy is admissible where the violation of the collective
right to a healthy environment entails the violation of fundamental rights connected
to it.
